## Overview

In this project, joint with [Jeremy Horowitz](https://www.jeremy-horowitz.com/){target="_blank"} and [Kristin Michelitch](https://sites.google.com/site/kristinmichelitch/home/){target="_blank"}, we study attitudes towards clientelism and its connection with ethnic and partisan identities in Kenya.

Using lab-in-the-field and survey experiments, the project examines how citizens evaluate clientelistic exchanges, when voters are willing to sanction or reward particularistic distribution, and how ethnic and partisan loyalties interact to shape political accountability in weak-party settings.
